17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2342-46 West Jackson Boulevard, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: §_B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

Lot Area: Approximately 9,660 square feet
2342 W. Jackson Blvd.: 4,060 square feet
2346 W. Jackson Blvd.: 5,600 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant intends to divide the zoning lot into two (2) separate zoning
lots so the newly created zoning lot at 2346 West Jackson Boulevard can be
developed with a new five-story fifteen (15) dwelling unit residential
building. The proposed building will measure approximately 55 ft. in height
and be supported by four (4) off-street parking spaces. The height and
footprint of the existing four (4) dwelling unit residential building and
detached garage at 2342 West Jackson Boulevard will remain without
change. The subject property is a Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the CTA Western Bus Line Corridor. Pursuant to Sec, 17-13-
0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to
Secs. 17-13-1003-EE, 17-13-1101-B, and 17-13-1003-L of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking
requirement from eight (8) parking spaces to four (4) parking spaces, reduce
the rear setback to 5 ft., and increase the building height to 55 ft. for 2346
West Jackson Boulevard and reduce the off-street parking from four (4)
parking spaces to two (2) parking spaces, reduce the front setback to 6 ft.,
reduce the west side setback to 1.19 inches and the east side setback to zero
for a total combined side setback reduction to 1.19 inches for 2342 West
Jackson Boulevard, and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio:
a. 2342 W. Jackson Blvd.: 4,460.5 square feet (1.1 FAR) existing to
remain.
b. 2346 W. Jackson Blvd.: 21,120 square feet (3.78 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):
a. 2342 W. Jackson Blvd.: 1,015 square feet per D.U.
(4 residential units) (existing to remain)
b. 2346 W. Jackson Blvd.: 373.33 square feet per D.U.
(15 residential units)

(C) — The amount of off-street parking:
a. *2342 W. Jackson Blvd.: 2 parking spaces
b. #2346 W. Jackson Blvd.: 4 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its

Sec. 17-3-0308 Criteria for Transit-Served Locations — Supplemental Narrative Zoning Analysis

1. The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location per Sec. 17-10-0102-B
because it is located within approximately 145 linear feet of the Western CTA bus line
corridor (route 49) and within 819 feet of the Western CTA Blue Line Rail station. The
proposed residential building at 2346 West Jackson Boulevard, which will contain fifteen
(15) residential units, will be supported by four (4) off-street parking spaces. The existing
residential building at 2342 West Jackson Boulevard, which contains four (4)-residential
units, will be supported by two (2) off-street parking spaces. Pursuant to Section 17-13-
1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the residential off-street parking ratio for 2342
West Jackson Boulevard from four (4) parking spaces to two (2) parking spaces and for
2346 West Jackson Boulevard from eight (8) parking spaces to four (4) parking spaces.

2. The Applicant’s building design complies with the main building door and entryway design
standards provided by Sec. 17-4-0504 because the main residential entrance of the
proposed building at 2346 West Jackson Boulevard fronts along West Jackson Boulevard
and the proposed front setback is 3 feet. Furthermore, the entrance widths do not exceed
12 ft., the entrance depths do not exceed the entrance width, the entrances are not more
than two-stories in height, and the proposed building elevations comply with the window
transparency requirements.

3. The Transit Friendly Development Guide defines ‘transit friendly development’ as
development which is oriented towards and integrated with adjacent transit. The proposed
residential building incorporates accessibility and connectivity to mass transit based on its
location near the Western CTA Blue Line Rail Station and the Western CTA Bus Line
Corridor. The Applicant believes the development will improve the subject area for
residents and other commuters traveling in the subject area.

4. The proposed residential building at 2346 West Jackson Boulevard will contain fifteen (15)
residential units. The proposed building will be supported by four (4) off-street parking
spaces and fifteen (15) onsite bicycle parking spaces. The existing building at 2342 West
Jackson Boulevard contains four (4) dwelling units and is supported by two (2) off-street
parking spaces. The Applicant is seeking administrative approval to permit the off-street
parking ratio reduction (4 parking spaces proposed at 2346 West Jackson Boulevard and 2
existing parking spaces at 2342 West Jackson Boulevard) for the residential units pursuant
to the TOD Ordinance.

5. The Applicant believes the proposed residential building at 2346 West Jackson Boulevard
will provide appropriate density in the subject neighborhood. More specifically, the project
will replace vacant and unimproved land with a five-story residential building. The existing
two-story four (4) dwelling unit building at 2342 West Jackson Boulevard will remain
without change. The new residential units will provide additional residential housing
inventory to meet market demand. Based on the subject property’s proximity to mass
transit, the Applicant believes the project provides transit options and otherwise complies
with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules promulgated by the Department
of Transportation by serving an area in need.
